unlisted_practices: Stage-consistent multi-agent counseling workflow (Exploration-Insight-Action) with adaptive routing across SFBT, CBT, and MBCT
Recording agent producing standardized case formulations, therapeutic records, and relapse-prevention plans for interpretability and accountability
Scale-guided LLM evaluation combining therapy-specific clinical scales with general counseling criteria

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks XInsight, a multi-agent LLM counseling framework evaluated on an automated benchmark (XInsight-Bench). It proposes a novel agent architecture rather than evaluating a specific deployer guardrail or operational practice.
